name: topological_readout_ob3ect

phase_0.boundary_condition: the strand guard (14 strands) and the evaluation point t=1/5 — the closed circuit that contains the whole readout; (a, N) enters, the period r leaves, nothing else crosses

VINIT.justification: the uninitialized input before anything is named — void, seed, nothing measured yet

TANCH.justification: the Jones root that closes the invariant's domain — the terminal anchor containing the whole measurement; the strand guard bounds it

AFWD.justification: the forward morphism from the pair (a, N) to the ModExp braid word — directed transformation toward the invariant

AREV.justification: the descent from the complex amplitude to the winding coordinate — atan2(V) → turns → winding fraction; the reverse morphism

CLINK.justification: braid assembly composed with the single evaluation composed with the winding readout — sequential chaining of the stages

IMSCRIB.justification: the phase recognizes itself as off the tenths lattice — identity of the invariant's value, deterministic across runs (137/250 reproduced byte-identical)

FSPLIT.justification: the one evaluation of V at t=1/5 splits into its two coordinates — Re(V) and Im(V), the T-arm and F-arm of the complex value

FFUSE.justification: the two coordinates reconstitute the invariant V = Re + i·Im — the fusion that restores the split input exactly (μ∘δ=id)

EVALT.justification: affirmative readout: residual > 0, the invariant off the tenths lattice — the authentic one-shot signature (verdict: snapped)

EVALF.justification: negative readout: residual < 1e-6, the invariant IS the winding exactly (verdict: ON LATTICE)

ENGAGR.justification: both readings held: the period is deterministic from braid structure AND the amplitude is a continuous mixture through golden-ratio amplitudes — a paradice held without resolution

IFIX.justification: the irreversible fixed-point record a^r ≡ 1 (mod N) — the unmoved mover, the readout's permanent output

phase_2.split_input: the Jones invariant V(a,N) at t=1/5 — one complex value
split_outputs: Re(V): the real coordinate of the invariant
Im(V): the imaginary coordinate of the invariant
phase_2.fuse_element: the complex reconstruction V = Re + i·Im
phase_2.fuse_result: the Jones invariant V(a,N) at t=1/5 — one complex value

phase_3.void_description: the uninitialized (a, N) pair — before the braid exists, nothing is named
phase_3.true_description: the affirmative readout — the phase off the tenths lattice, the authentic one-shot invariant (verdict: snapped)
phase_3.false_description: the negative readout — the phase on the lattice, the invariant identical to the winding (verdict: ON LATTICE)
phase_3.both_description: the dialetheic hold — deterministic period from braid structure AND continuous golden-ratio mixture in the amplitude, both true, neither resolved

steps.domain_action: the coprime pair (a, N) enters uninitialized — nothing is named yet
the evaluation point t=1/5 is fixed — the Jones root closes the invariant's domain
the strand guard (>14 refuses) bounds the braid — the containing limit of the readout
assemble_shor_braid(a, N) builds the ModExp braid word — the forward morphism from pair to braid
the braid word is composed with the invariant — the evaluation is the composition of assembly and measurement
the one evaluation of V at t=1/5 splits into its two coordinates — Re(V) and Im(V)
the real coordinate is read — Re(V) enters the affirmative arm
the imaginary coordinate is read — Im(V) enters the negative arm
the two coordinates reconstitute the invariant V = Re + i·Im — the fusion closes μ∘δ=id
winding_of(V) reads the phase — the invariant's identity, deterministic across runs
the phase advances to the period — the winding fraction maps to ord_N(a)
the descent from amplitude to coordinate — atan2(V) → turns → winding fraction (the reverse morphism)
the residual check — off the tenths lattice: authentic (verdict: snapped)
the residual check — on the lattice: the invariant IS the winding (verdict: ON LATTICE)
both readings held — deterministic period AND continuous golden-ratio mixture, no resolution
r = ord_N(a) is fixed — the irreversible record a^r ≡ 1 (mod N), the unmoved mover

phase_5.compiler_frontend: assemble_shor_braid — translates (a, N) into the ModExp braid word
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the braid word passes from assembly to evaluation as a typed word — the same address, no paraphrase
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the invariant V and its winding fraction — held in registers, read once
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the single evaluation — ONE winding, zero statistics; the order is the braid structure itself
phase_5.alfs_store: the canonical readout — fibqc readout in mOMonadOS, the verified binary (11/11 periods, Lean-formalized fixed point)

phase_6.cycle_cost: ONE Jones evaluation at t=1/5 per readout
phase_6.post_cycle_state: r = ord_N(a) — the period, the fixed point a^r ≡ 1 (mod N)
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the period is read from braid structure, deterministic; no statistics accumulated, no entropy produced

banked_count_check.verdict: 2 unit(s) of weight cleared with nothing banked behind them: the count was in the open when the reversal came
banked_count_check.remedy: open the region that holds the result BEFORE the region that computes it, and close them in that order, so the inner fuse folds into the enclosing frame rather than into the register
